---
title: "Script for calculating VMT over time inside and outside the CRZ in NYC"
author: Jada Potter
date: "11/18/26"
output:
  html_document:
    number_sections: true
---

```{r}
library(arcgis)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
```

Load the CRZ bounds from ArcGIS Rest server:

```{r}
crz = arc_open("https://services3.arcgis.com/zmk8NL9pBXO4ybJQ/arcgis/rest/services/MTA_Congestion_Relief_Zone_Boundary/FeatureServer/0") %>%
  arc_select

# Simplify the feature and change crs
crz = crz %>%
  select() %>%
  mutate(in_crz = T) %>%
  st_transform(2263)
```

Load and clean the traffic volume counts (locally)

```{r}
tvc = read.csv("./Automated_Traffic_Volume_Counts_20261117.csv")
tvc$Vol = gsub(",", "", tvc$Vol)
tvc$Vol = as.integer(tvc$Vol)

# Summarize traffic counts by month and make spatial
tvc_bymonth = tvc %>%
  select(-RequestID) %>%
  group_by(SegmentID, Boro, street, fromSt, toSt, Direction, Yr, M, WktGeom) %>%
  summarise(Vol_per_hr = mean(Vol)*4) %>% # note that Vol is taken in 15 min increments, so multiplying by 4 gets mean Vol per hour
  st_as_sf(wkt = "WktGeom", crs = 2263) # guessed correctly because they often use this

# Make a variable that's the month and year
tvc_bymonth$YrM = as.yearmon(paste(tvc_bymonth$Yr, tvc_bymonth$M), "%Y %m")
tvc_bymonth$Yr = NULL
tvc_bymonth$M = NULL

# Determine whether they're inside or outside the CRZ
tvc_bymonth = tvc_bymonth %>%
  st_join(crz)

# Replace NA with FALSE
tvc_bymonth$in_crz = replace_na(tvc_bymonth$in_crz, F)

# View on an interactive map to verify we've got the measurements in the right locations
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(tvc_bymonth) + tm_dots(col = "in_crz", palette = "Set1")
```

Summarize totals by study area over time

```{r}
tvc_bymonth_all = tvc_bymonth %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(YrM) %>%
  summarise(Vol_per_hr = mean(Vol_per_hr)) %>%
  mutate(Area = "All")

tvc_bymonth_in_crz = tvc_bymonth %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(in_crz == T) %>%
  group_by(YrM) %>%
  summarise(Vol_per_hr = mean(Vol_per_hr)) %>%
  mutate(Area = "CRZ")

tvc_bymonth_out_crz = tvc_bymonth %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(in_crz == F) %>%
  group_by(YrM) %>%
  summarise(Vol_per_hr = mean(Vol_per_hr)) %>%
  mutate(Area = "Outside CRZ")

tvc_bymonth_byArea = bind_rows(tvc_bymonth_in_crz, tvc_bymonth_out_crz)
```

Graphs

```{r}
ggplot(tvc_bymonth_byArea, aes(x=YrM, y=Vol_per_hr, group = Area)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = Area)) +
  ggtitle("Average traffic counts per camera per hour over time, inside and outside the CRZ") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2022, 2026.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2000)) +
  ylab("Avg. count per camera per hour") +
  xlab("Year")
```
